problem.title: L-LO on KITTI Odom seq 08 full (4071 frames)
problem.question: How close does the landmark convex-hull odometry get to the paper's KITTI numbers with this repository's parameter choices?

variants.label: Default
variants.intent: Repository defaults (the paper gives no numeric parameters).
variants.note: Landmark convex-hull overlap odometry, frame-to-frame (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose). mean_matches=32.6204 frames_below_3_matches=0/4070
variants.readability_note: Uses the default CLI surface only.
variants.extensibility_note: No extra profile knobs beyond the stable core contract.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.

variants.label: Seq 07 tuned
variants.intent: Best 100 m RPE on seq 07 across the l_lo_kitti_seq_07_*_sweep manifests (cluster_cell 0.25, ground_tolerance 0.15, max_range 80); applied unchanged, this sequence was not used for choosing.
variants.command: build/evaluation/pcd_dogfooding dogfooding_results/kitti_seq_08_full experiments/reference_data/kitti_seq_08_full_gt.csv --methods l_lo --summary-json experiments/results/runs/l_lo_kitti_seq_08_full_matrix/seq07_tuned/summary.json --l-lo-set cluster_cell=0.25 --l-lo-set ground_tolerance=0.15 --l-lo-set max_range=80
variants.note: Landmark convex-hull overlap odometry, frame-to-frame (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose). mean_matches=43.3509 frames_below_3_matches=0/4070
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Close enough to the current default to keep as a live alternative.
